profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Indeed
profile.summary:
I am a Principal Software Engineer with years of experience in delivering Java solutions across many different technology stacks.  I enjoy a healthy challenge of solving technical problems, leading teams to ideal solutions, while fully embracing the best kind of keep it simple mindset as possible.

I have helped work on many varying sizes of projects in various roles, from individual contributor to tech lead/team lead level responsibilities.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on various technologies such as building out ci/cd pipelines using gitlab, worked on both monolithic and private cloud architectures, using rest and dabbling in technology here or there.  I also helped by contributing to set up the companies pipeline, developer workstation options, and platform and developer experience in our new technology stack.

positions.title: Software Developer/Integrater I
positions.description:
In my time at USAA, I have had the opportunity to work on many critical applications and projects.

1.)  Corporate Change of Address (CCOA) - integrated all mailing address changes between the customer enterprise address and all of the product level addresses.  This was integrating different vendor and vendor customized solutions into our standard way/direction.  I helped in design and was lead developer on this project, which was originally supposed to be a 3 year, 3 million dollar journey in 8 months, for 3 million dollars delivering more functionality than what was originally planed for in the original 3 million dollars.  Since implementation, there have been no issues with this product brought up by the business.

2.)  Modular Eligibility - Was a critical resource/lead developer of a component of this project.  We changed the way our enterprise handled membership at the new member level, allowing more prospective members to join USAA.

3.)  Reg-O - Was a critical resource/developer of a component for this project.  We had to capture assessments about certain members that fit into a category for regulatory purposes.  We were able to provide an enterprise solution for the business, which has been stable and has kept regulators at bay. 

4.)  Migrate off of Host - developed code to retrieve from UDB database using Hibernate rather than our Host backend to start our journey to get off of host.

Outside of the projects/efforts I have worked (not all mentioned here), I have successfully been leading 2 components at work, have tech lead projects to success, and have fixed high priority defects and helped my peers in identifying problems as they arise.

Some of my skill sets are as applies:

Web Services
J2EE
Flexible Infrastructure
Websphere
Java Batch
Front end - java tier
Host (soon, not just yet)
Hibernate
Troubleshooting complicated problems

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description: IT Intern in Testing Center of Excellence.  I helped with the testing of the EFAM repository.

positions.title: Intern - Automation
positions.description: Worked in the Automation Testing department of JP Morgan as an intern.  Worked on their automated testing framework to enhance it, fix bugs in it, etc.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin

honors.title: 2nd Place in Belts and Suspenders Competition
honors.description: I got second place in a competition where we were to implement solutions in our domains that would continue to make us highly available, such as eliminating single points of failures, and fixing critical defects.

honors.title: Pride Tribue - February 2013
honors.description: A project needed some help with a problem, and had no one else to go to.  They came to me because of my general knowledge of our environment, and I was able to help them within that day with a problem they had struggled with for almost a month.
